Subject: Discovery recap & integration plan - Redwood PoC (Nimbus Retail)

Hi Alicia / Tom -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we discussed and proposed next steps so we're all aligned: 

Pain points / goals
- Slow search relevance on product pages; conversion drop on high-traffic promotions
- Need predictable per-query latency under 150ms p95 for search + autocomplete
- Want to reduce embedding + rerank cost without regressing CTR or A/B metrics

Current stack
- Frontend: React-based storefront with server-side rendering
- Search: ElasticSearch for indexing + a simple boosting layer
- Serving: Hosted microservices on GCP (us-west1)

Success criteria for PoC
1) End-to-end integration with Redwood API for embeddings + reranking on a 10k product catalog
2) P95 inference latency <= 150ms for autocomplete and rerank in test traffic
3) No >2% regression in click-through from baseline; prefer measurable lift in relevance signals

Proposed PoC / onboarding plan (high-level)
- SDKs: start with Python backend integration (Flask service) + lightweight JS snippet for client-side autocomplete testing
- API compatibility: Redwood REST endpoints + example SDK calls - no model changes required for initial run
- Timeline: kickoff next week (wk of 2026-03-16), 3-week PoC (week 1: integration, week 2: data + test traffic, week 3: evaluation + handoff)
- Owners: Marissa (Redwood AE) - program owner; Monica (Solutions Engineer) - integration lead; Tom/Alicia - Nimbus engineering/product leads

Next steps (agreed)
1) I'll send the PoC milestone doc and a stub dataset template by tomorrow (attached).
2) Monica will share a short integration checklist (SDK examples / auth) and a follow-up call to review CORS and client JS options.
3) Schedule kickoff with engineering: propose Tue 2026-03-17 10:00 AM PT - confirm if that works.

Attachments: nimbus_requirements.pdf (PoC requirements), poc_milestones.xlsx (timeline + owners)

Thanks - excited to get started.

--

Thanks Marissa - this looks great and captures everything from the call. A few clarifications from our side:

- Latency: the 150ms p95 requirement is for the full round-trip (client -> our service -> Redwood -> client). We'll need to put timeboxing on client-side debounce for autocomplete.
- Dataset: Tom will prepare a 10k product export and share a sample JSON by Monday. Expect some missing metadata on ~5% of products.
- Auth: for the PoC we can use a scoped API key; procurement will require an NDA/contract for production.

Kickoff: Tue 2026-03-17 10:00 AM PT works for our engineering leads.

One ask: can Monica confirm the Python SDK sample will include a simple batching example and a token/cost estimate for 10k product re-ranks per day? That will help procurement model costs.

Happy to sync live on Mon if you want a quick pre-kickoff sync.
